annotations.title: Look up a US public company in SEC EDGAR (paid)

description: Use to verify a US listed company or SEC registrant: finds it by name, ticker or CIK and returns its SEC record (legal name, former names, tickers and exchanges, EIN, state of incorporation, industry code, business address, latest 10-K/20-F and 10-Q dates). Private US companies are not in EDGAR. Input: name, ticker or cik. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402, or 5 credits of a Factline API key.
name: us_company_lookup
title: Look up a US public company in SEC EDGAR (paid)
